d:
In this video, we walk through Kite Screener, a new tool that lets you filter the market and act on stocks without leaving Kite.
Until now, screening usually happened outside your trading platform. You would scan a list on a screener, check charts and fundamentals elsewhere, then return to Kite to add a stock to your watchlist or place an order. Kite Screener brings all of that into one place. You can choose a stock universe, apply custom filters or ready-made presets, and then review a stock, add it to your watchlist, view charts, create a GTT, or place an order directly from the results.
